title: Combinatorial invariance of Kazhdan–Lusztig polynomials
summary: We prove that an isomorphism of Bruhat intervals in arbitrary Coxeter systems preserves their equal-parameter Kazhdan–Lusztig polynomials. This resolves the full combinatorial invariance conjecture positively.

review.reason: Proves combinatorial invariance of Kazhdan-Lusztig polynomials across Bruhat intervals in Coxeter systems.
